purpose: Product-level manual frontend task corpus; Core remains product-agnostic.

cases.title: Open exact CMDB configuration item
cases.task: Open the saved U-Connect stand, find one exact named CMDB row, open it, and verify the details surface.
checks: details surface belongs to the same CI
browser remains on the saved stand origin

cases.title: Navigate configuration item tabs
cases.task: For one exact CMDB item, open each requested visible tab and verify that the selected tab and panel agree.

cases.title: Filter a CMDB table
cases.task: Apply one exact non-destructive table filter and verify the visible rows and reported total without changing records.
checks: filter control contains the requested value
clearing the filter restores the prior view

cases.title: Verify CMDB pagination
cases.task: Inspect pagination, move to one adjacent page, and verify the visible range and row identity without bulk actions.
checks: visible range is consistent with total
selected-row ledger is not treated as product evidence

cases.title: Verify one sortable column
cases.task: Toggle one exact sortable header and verify the observed order, then restore the initial sort state.

cases.title: Validate required fields without submit
cases.task: Inspect one exact form and verify required-field, label, description, and native validation contracts without submitting it.

cases.title: Edit and persist a disposable frontend fixture
cases.task: Change one allowed field on an owned disposable resource, save it, reopen it, and verify persistence and absence of unrelated changes.

cases.title: Walk a modal wizard without final submit
cases.task: Open one exact wizard, verify step transitions and Back behavior, then close it without Save or Submit.
checks: Next and Back change the active step

cases.title: Read exact agent telemetry
cases.task: Open Agent for one exact CI and verify UI, CI, agent, and monitoring status with freshness evidence.
checks: evidence belongs to the exact CI

cases.title: Audit installed agent plugins
cases.task: For one exact CI, inspect the observed plugin list and verify one requested plugin name, version, and freshness.
checks: plugin belongs to the selected agent

cases.title: Run managed non-periodic agent task
cases.task: Create one allowlisted managed executeCommand fixture for an exact online CI, verify its closed result, register it in the ledger, and disable it during cleanup.
checks: task identity matches the exact agent
closed result matches the private marker

cases.title: Verify periodic agent task second run
cases.task: For an owned periodic managed task, prove a second completed run by a newer processed timestamp without exposing command output.

cases.title: Inspect VNC surface readiness
cases.task: Inspect the exact remote-console iframe and verify surface readiness and frame change without sending keyboard or pointer input.

cases.title: Check three fixed viewport profiles
cases.task: Open one exact U-Connect page under mobile, tablet, and desktop profiles and report horizontal overflow and hidden critical controls.

cases.title: Run page accessibility and health audit
cases.task: Audit one exact page for accessible names, broken ARIA references, headings, landmarks, contrast, target size, console errors, and failed requests.
checks: response bodies and stack traces are not exposed

cases.title: Verify a generated report download
cases.task: Trigger one expected report download and verify filename, format signature, hash when known, and safe structural bounds without returning file contents.
checks: contents are not returned to the model
